Milky Mist sees limited impact from inflation, El Niño as revenue grows 42%
india_trends.summary: Milky Mist posted a strong September quarter, with revenue rising 42% and profit jumping 175%, helped by strong demand for value-added dairy products and selective price hikes. The company says inflation, El Niño and geopolitical uncertainties have had limited impact.

india_trends.title: Suzlon faces Adani, JSW challenge as wind energy market heats up; Q2 margins take a hit
india_trends.summary: Suzlon Energy faces intensifying competition from Adani, JSW and other players in India's wind energy market, even as its revenue grew 26% year-on-year to Rs 4,869 crore in Q2 FY27. EBITDA remained flat at Rs 720 crore, while the EBITDA margin narrowed to 14.8% from 18.6% a year earlier.

india_trends.title: Ambuja Cements expects volume growth to outpace industry in H2
india_trends.summary: Trade volumes grew 8.6% in Q2FY27, but weakness in institutional sales kept overall volumes broadly flat. The company expects both segments to return to growth in the second half.

india_trends.title: Jio Platforms first Q2 results after bumper listing: check date; Reliance firm’s earnings in focus; key numbers to watch
india_trends.summary: Jio Platforms will announce its Q2 FY27 results on October 30, its first earnings report since listing. The company reported 9.2% annual profit growth in Q1, while revenue rose 12% and ARPU increased 3.3%.
